headline: Bajaj Electricals gets GST relief of ₹29.63 lakh
summary: Bajaj Electricals received a favourable appellate order setting aside a GST demand of ₹29.63 lakh for FY18, including a penalty of ₹2.69 lakh.

headline: Xtranet AGM approves all five resolutions
summary: Xtranet Technologies passed all five resolutions at its 25th AGM, including re-appointments of directors and adoption of FY26 financials.

headline: Signoria Creation wins Rs 2.85 crore order from Zivore Apparel
summary: Signoria Creation secured a Rs 2.85 crore work order for garment manufacturing. The order represents 5.8% of average quarterly revenue. No prior order history disclosed in last 3 quarters.
